lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
forms-submit: 871 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 871 B.
forms-main: 871 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 871 B.
forms-settings: 674 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 674 B.
All 4 pages load the same 2 files: 607,552 B raw, 165,427 B gzip, 95.6 % of the smallest page (forms-emptyContent, 635,352 B).
Inside: @nextcloud/vue 428,865 B, @vue/runtime-core 48,578 B, dompurify 30,346 B, vue-router 24,014 B, @vue/reactivity 17,996 B.
css holds 4 stylesheets, 351,129 B, and no page of this build loads any of them: no entry in js is named after one, and none is reached from an entry that is.

Loaded from PHP: embedded.css (lib/Controller/PageController.php), forms-style.css (lib/Controller/PageController.php), forms.css (lib/Controller/PageController.php), public.css (lib/Controller/PageController.php).
Each is loaded from PHP or built into the bundle, so none is left without a loader. Where the build writes its stylesheets somewhere else, --css=DIR names that directory.
moment, 301,677 B on the forms-submit page: carries its locale data; luxon and date-fns are a fraction of it.
9 B in 1 piece of 1 file have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (129 packages, 1,282 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js is left without something that loads it.
